description: This file defines CRUD and listing operations for 'project' entities in a crowdfunding platform backend, including functions for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing projects with filtering options.

methods.name: createProject({ owner_id, title, description, goal_amount, deadline, category })
methods.description: Creates a new project record in the database with given project details.

methods.name: getProjectById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a project by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listProjects({ q, category, owner_id, limit = 20, offset = 0 })
methods.description: Lists projects with optional filtering by query term, category, owner, with pagination.

methods.name: updateProject(id, owner_id, payload)
methods.description: Updates specific fields of a project, given project id, owner id, and payload with new data.

methods.name: deleteProject(id, owner_id)
methods.description: Deletes a project identified by id and owner id.

ctags.name: createProject
ctags.pattern: /^async function createProject({ owner_id, title, description, goal_amount, deadline, category }) /
ctags.signature: ({ owner_id, title, description, goal_amount, deadline, category })

ctags.name: listProjects
ctags.pattern: /^async function listProjects({ q, category, owner_id, limit = 20, offset = 0 }) {$/
